- Prompt/evals: run A/B tests and canary rollouts; require automated regression gating — alert on drop in NPS/accuracy on curated prompt set.
- Cost sensitivity: target blended cost per user < $0.02 per conversation (ballpark).

- Needs Dedicated pricing sheet + committed QPS tiers; ask finance for 12-month reserved options and burst policies.
- Security wants a short-run SOC2 + KMS architecture diagram; also asked about data residency options (EU).
